outcome.interpretation_limit: The change preserves selected correction counts and exact references in the compact path; it does not establish reduced agent effort or complete visibility of the broader projection.

pressure_hypothesis.title: ECI compaction can hide verified record-correction provenance
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A selected campaign page omitted the correction row and counts; the compaction change retains bounded correction counts and target-to-correction references for inspection.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: When response compaction retains a linked campaign path, preserve bounded append-only record-correction counts and exact target and correction evidence references so agents can inspect how the projected definition was established.
pressure_hypothesis.recurrence: one selected campaign-window response; recurrence across other response shapes or sessions is not established
not_measured: agent time or tool calls caused by the omitted correction details
frequency of correction-summary omission across other evidence windows
whether the omission changed a development decision

improvement_relation.basis: The exact implementation blob is integrity-addressed. The focused regression passes and the live ECI readback exposes correction counts of one total, one applied, zero unverified, plus exact target and correction references.
not_measured: agent intervention burden or time saved
response behavior for unrelated evidence families
cross-session recurrence or causal effect on development outcomes

measurement_limits: The live response remains partial and compacts four of five selected campaign records; this change preserves a bounded correction summary rather than every source row.
Verification and readback do not measure agent receipt, intervention reduction, recurrence, or sustained effectiveness.
